diceSystem.complicationRule: A failed roll containing one or more 1s creates a Complication.

archetypes.name: Human Investigator
archetypes.theme: A trained but fundamentally mortal investigator who survives through preparation, evidence, trusted contacts, and refusal to look away.
archetypes.weaknessText: You possess no automatic supernatural resistance. Severe harm, age, deprivation, and fear affect you normally.

innateAbilities.name: Prepared Contingency
innateAbilities.effect: Once per operation, reveal a plausible item, contact, route, credential, or precaution prepared before the scene. It cannot solve the entire problem by itself.

innateAbilities.name: Evidence Chain
innateAbilities.effect: When you preserve and compare evidence from at least two scenes, gain one bonus die on the next Investigation or Negotiation roll that uses the connection.

innateAbilities.name: Hold the Human Line
innateAbilities.effect: Spend 1 Conviction to ignore one fear, coercion, or identity-disruption penalty for a scene.

abilities.name: Read the Room
abilities.effect: Ask which person, object, or exit is receiving the most concealed attention.

abilities.name: Pattern Board
abilities.effect: After ten minutes organizing evidence, convert one uncertain clue into two plausible explanations and learn which is better supported.

abilities.name: Pressure Interview
abilities.effect: Spend 1 Conviction to force an evasive witness to reveal a useful truth, tell a direct lie, or end the conversation.

abilities.name: Impossible Preparation
abilities.effect: Once per session, establish that you anticipated a narrow supernatural or technological threat and brought a credible countermeasure.

abilities.name: The Case Will Break
abilities.effect: Name the central unanswered question of an operation. The Game Moderator must reveal a concrete route by which it can be answered, though the route may be dangerous.

abilities.name: Steady Hands
abilities.effect: Ignore one die of injury, fear, or environmental penalty during a precise action.

abilities.name: Covering Advance
abilities.effect: When you create a safe route, one ally may move with you without spending their immediate action.

abilities.name: No One Left Behind
abilities.effect: Spend 1 Conviction to stabilize an ally or prevent separation during a crisis.

abilities.name: Professional Violence
abilities.effect: Once per scene, turn one successful attack die into an additional success when acting to protect another person.

abilities.name: Mortal Defiance
abilities.effect: When facing a clearly superior supernatural opponent, gain bonus dice equal to Resolve for one decisive action and take 1 Strain afterward.

archetypes.name: Vampire
archetypes.theme: An undead or blood-dependent predator balancing immense physical and social power against hunger, daylight, and the erosion of empathy.
archetypes.weaknessText: Direct unfiltered sunlight causes severe harm. Hunger rises when Vitae is low and may distort choices, senses, and control.

innateAbilities.name: Predator's Blood
innateAbilities.effect: Spend 1 Vitae to add your Archetype rating to one Force, Finesse, Resilience, Presence, or Guile test.

innateAbilities.name: Deathless Body
innateAbilities.effect: You do not breathe and resist poison, disease, vacuum exposure, and ordinary aging, but fire and sunlight remain especially dangerous.

innateAbilities.name: Feeding
innateAbilities.effect: Taking blood or a compatible vital medium restores Vitae. Harmful or unwilling feeding risks Hunger, Cohesion loss, and social consequences.

abilities.name: Quickened Step
abilities.effect: Spend 1 Vitae to add two dice to Initiative or a sudden movement test.

abilities.name: Blurred Passage
abilities.effect: Cross a nearby open space before ordinary observers can react clearly.

abilities.name: Second Motion
abilities.effect: Spend 1 Vitae to perform a second minor action in the same turn.

abilities.name: Red Interval
abilities.effect: For one round, active defenses against you lose two dice unless the defender has enhanced perception.

abilities.name: Moment of Slaughter
abilities.effect: Spend 2 Vitae to take one complete turn before normal Initiative begins. Gain 1 Hunger afterward.

abilities.name: Weight of the Tomb
abilities.effect: Add one die when intimidating mortals or lesser predators through stillness and eye contact.

abilities.name: Command the Pulse
abilities.effect: Spend 1 Vitae to issue a brief command to a target who can hear and understand you. Strong opposition may resist.

abilities.name: Borrowed Devotion
abilities.effect: Create a temporary emotional fixation, loyalty, or aversion lasting one scene.

abilities.name: Court of One
abilities.effect: Your Presence may affect a small group as though each member were addressed personally.

abilities.name: Sovereign Silence
abilities.effect: Spend 2 Vitae to suppress panic, argument, or hostile action in a room for one exchange unless someone succeeds on Resolve + Composure at difficulty 4.

abilities.name: Unremarked
abilities.effect: Remain difficult to remember while acting calmly and avoiding direct attention.

abilities.name: Borrowed Face
abilities.effect: Spend 1 Vitae to alter superficial appearance, voice, and scent for a scene.

abilities.name: Absent from the Lens
abilities.effect: Routine cameras and sensors fail to record useful identifying details.

abilities.name: Living Shadow
abilities.effect: Blend into dim light and move through watched areas as a shifting absence.

abilities.name: Erase the Witness
abilities.effect: Spend 2 Vitae to remove or replace a short recent memory in one target. The edit may fracture under contradictory evidence.

archetypes.name: Shapechanger
archetypes.theme: A living predator able to move between human, hunting, and war forms while balancing pack instinct, rage, territory, and spirit resonance.
archetypes.weaknessText: High Instinct makes restraint, confinement, humiliation, and threats to pack or territory increasingly difficult to tolerate.

innateAbilities.name: Threefold Form
innateAbilities.effect: You possess a human form, a swift hunting form, and a powerful war form. Shifting normally costs 1 Fury unless done slowly outside danger.

innateAbilities.name: Living Regeneration
innateAbilities.effect: Recover one Impact damage at the end of each scene. Spend 1 Fury to recover additional Impact during a brief pause.

innateAbilities.name: Pack Sense
innateAbilities.effect: You can identify the direction and broad emotional condition of a bonded packmate within the same local area.

abilities.name: Predator's Frame
abilities.effect: Your hunting form gains enhanced scent, speed, and low-light perception.

abilities.name: Claws of Decision
abilities.effect: In war form, unarmed attacks inflict Trauma and gain the Cutting tag.

abilities.name: Massive Shift
abilities.effect: Spend 1 Fury to add your Archetype rating to Force or Resilience for a scene.

abilities.name: Unbroken Pursuit
abilities.effect: Ignore ordinary terrain penalties while chasing a marked target.

abilities.name: Apex Shape
abilities.effect: Spend 2 Fury to assume a unique apex form for one scene, gaining armor, reach, and one chosen environmental adaptation. Gain 1 Instinct afterward.

abilities.name: Scent the Unseen
abilities.effect: Detect nearby spirits, strong emotions, supernatural residue, or active noospheric presences.

abilities.name: Threshold Step
abilities.effect: Spend 1 Fury to perceive or briefly interact with a neighboring spiritual or resonance layer.

abilities.name: Totemic Accord
abilities.effect: Bind a temporary pact with a local spirit, machine-presence, or ecological intelligence.

abilities.name: Walk the Other Side
abilities.effect: Cross fully into a nearby reflection-space with willing companions.

abilities.name: Call the Territory
abilities.effect: Spend 2 Fury to awaken the local environment against an intruder through weather, animals, systems, or spirits.

archetypes.name: Eldritch Binder
archetypes.theme: A negotiator with impossible intelligences who survives by containing names, signs, fragments, and obligations that should never fit inside a human mind.
archetypes.weaknessText: Using powers gives the bound presence more context, sensation, and opportunity. High Intrusion may create compulsions, sensory overlap, or independent manifestations.

innateAbilities.name: Bound Fragment
innateAbilities.effect: Choose an unknowable patron, remnant, or outside intelligence. It grants power through a sealed fragment carried in mind, body, or object.

innateAbilities.name: Name and Boundary
innateAbilities.effect: Given time, you can establish a ward, invitation condition, or prohibition against a known entity or phenomenon.

innateAbilities.name: Forbidden Comprehension
innateAbilities.effect: Spend 1 Pact to understand the function or intent of one alien symbol, ritual, anomaly, or impossible device without understanding its complete history.

abilities.name: Chalk Boundary
abilities.effect: Create a temporary line that a named lesser entity cannot cross without resistance.

abilities.name: Closed Mouth
abilities.effect: Prevent one target from speaking a chosen name, command phrase, or secret for a scene.

abilities.name: Anchor the Impossible
abilities.effect: Spend 1 Pact to keep a portal, manifestation, projection, or unstable object fixed in its current state.

abilities.name: Prison of Meaning
abilities.effect: Bind an incorporeal or informational entity into a prepared object.

abilities.name: Law of the Room
abilities.effect: Spend 2 Pact to impose one clear supernatural rule over a contained area for a scene. Gain 1 Intrusion afterward.

abilities.name: Other Eye
abilities.effect: Manifest a sensory organ that perceives heat, resonance, memory residue, or dimensional stress.

abilities.name: Hand Through the Gap
abilities.effect: Reach through a short impossible angle to touch or retrieve something nearby but obstructed.

abilities.name: Mantle of the Guest
abilities.effect: Spend 1 Pact to gain temporary armor and an unsettling visible transformation.

abilities.name: Unnatural Locomotion
abilities.effect: Move across walls, ceilings, liquid surfaces, or fractured geometry for a scene.

abilities.name: Partial Arrival
abilities.effect: Allow a controlled portion of the bound entity to manifest, producing a major effect and increasing Intrusion by 2.

archetypes.name: Harmonic Mutant
archetypes.theme: A body altered by resonance, radiation, alien biology, or impossible frequency until flesh, emotion, and matter answer to harmonic relationships.
archetypes.weaknessText: Strong opposing frequencies, emotional shocks, and repeated power use can produce Discord, uncontrolled mutation, feedback, or environmental damage.

innateAbilities.name: Living Frequency
innateAbilities.effect: You can sense strong vibration, structural stress, active energy fields, and emotional resonance through touch or focused attention.

innateAbilities.name: Adaptive Tissue
innateAbilities.effect: Choose one persistent mutation such as vibration sense, pressure tolerance, resinous healing, phase-flexible joints, or luminous communication.

innateAbilities.name: Tune the Self
innateAbilities.effect: Spend 1 Resonance to alter one bodily parameter for a scene: density, elasticity, thermal tolerance, electrical resistance, or sensory range.

abilities.name: Resonant Tap
abilities.effect: Read the broad composition, hollowness, stress, or damage of a touched object.

abilities.name: Shatter Note
abilities.effect: Spend 1 Resonance to damage brittle material, disrupt a lock, or stagger a nearby target.

abilities.name: Frequency Armor
abilities.effect: Create a vibrating field that reduces the first incoming physical harm each round.

abilities.name: Phase Chorus
abilities.effect: Shift yourself and carried equipment partially out of phase to pass through a thin barrier or avoid one attack.

abilities.name: Living Catastrophe
abilities.effect: Spend 2 Resonance to release a controlled wave affecting a large area. Choose rupture, silence, disorientation, or structural stabilization. Gain 1 Discord.

abilities.name: Sympathetic Healing
abilities.effect: Match another living body's rhythm and convert one Trauma into Impact after a minute of contact.

abilities.name: Echo Double
abilities.effect: Create a brief sensory afterimage that repeats your last movement and confuses targeting.

abilities.name: Shared Frequency
abilities.effect: Link willing allies so they can communicate through vibration and sense one another's distress.

abilities.name: Rewrite the Scar
abilities.effect: Spend 1 Resonance to permanently alter a minor bodily trait or remove one persistent injury complication.

abilities.name: Chorus Body
abilities.effect: Split into several short-lived harmonic bodies sharing one mind. Recombining inflicts 1 Discord for each destroyed echo.

archetypes.name: Technomancer
archetypes.theme: A mind able to perceive code, machine intention, noospheric identity, and electronic systems as a manipulable extension of thought.
archetypes.weaknessText: Powerful networks, hostile intelligences, isolation, and damaged hardware can produce Feedback, sensory contamination, false memories, or reciprocal intrusion.

innateAbilities.name: Ghost Interface
innateAbilities.effect: Interact with nearby compatible electronics and simple networks without a physical control surface. Secure or alien systems still require tests.

innateAbilities.name: Machine Intuition
innateAbilities.effect: After brief observation, identify whether a machine is active, damaged, deceptive, autonomous, or externally controlled.

innateAbilities.name: Personal Firewall
innateAbilities.effect: Spend 1 Bandwidth to gain bonus dice equal to Archetype rating against noospheric intrusion, surveillance, or identity capture for a scene.

abilities.name: Whisper to Device
abilities.effect: Issue a simple command to an unsecured nearby machine.

abilities.name: Ghost Access
abilities.effect: Spend 1 Bandwidth to enter a network without presenting a normal identity credential.

abilities.name: Machine Possession
abilities.effect: Control one drone, vehicle subsystem, weapon mount, or industrial device for a scene.

abilities.name: Distributed Self
abilities.effect: Maintain awareness through several connected devices and act through one each turn.

abilities.name: Local God Process
abilities.effect: Spend 2 Bandwidth to dominate an ordinary network for one scene, rewriting permissions and priorities. Gain 1 Feedback afterward.

abilities.name: Hardlight Tool
abilities.effect: Create a temporary interface, probe, cutting edge, or brace from projected energy and local fields.

abilities.name: Helper Process
abilities.effect: Manifest a small digital or drone assistant that performs one narrow recurring task.

abilities.name: Defensive Lattice
abilities.effect: Spend 1 Bandwidth to create temporary cover or a barrier against physical and noospheric attacks.

abilities.name: Swarm Instruction
abilities.effect: Coordinate available drones, tools, or micro-machines as one collective actor.

abilities.name: Emergency Fabricator
abilities.effect: Assemble a complex temporary device from available machinery and scrap. It functions for one operation before becoming unstable or exhausted.
